featured_reviews.review_text:
Some places aren’t just about food, they’re about memories — and Lucky Restaurant in Chembur is exactly that.
From the legendary biryani that never disappoints, to the old-school charm that feels like home, every visit is a trip down memory lane. Whether you come here with family or with the gang, Lucky has this magic of turning simple meals into unforgettable experiences. We had a very bad experience with the food and service here.

1. We ordered Mutton Handi, but nobody informed us that it would come as kebabs. We only found out when the dish was served. This kind of miscommunication is not acceptable.
2. We ordered Prawns Masala, and it was extremely sweet. After we complained, it was replaced, but this should not have happened in the first place.

featured_reviews.name: sagar warule
featured_reviews.review_text:
A fantastic spot for authentic Arabic cuisine! We began our meal with the Mandi Mutton Soup, which was incredibly aromatic, rich, and packed with deep flavors—very comforting. Next came the Turkish Tandoori Chicken, and it was a total winner: perfectly cooked, super creamy, and beautifully marinated. We absolutely loved it.

The Chicken Tandoori Mandi was our main course. It was a bit spicier than a traditional mandi, but the flavors were well-balanced and delicious, making it quite enjoyable.

For dessert, we tried Omali for the first time, and it completely stole the show! Soft, warm, mildly sweet, and very satisfying. We loved it so much that we ordered another serving. If you enjoy bread-based desserts, this is a must-try.

Overall, a very satisfying dining experience with great flavors throughout. Highly recommended for Arabic food lovers!

featured_reviews.name: Pakhare Akshay
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Arabian Darbar Hotel recently and overall had a really good experience.

We started with the Turkish tandoori chicken, and honestly, this was the highlight of the meal. The chicken was juicy, well cooked, and absolutely loaded with that mustard-based sauce. Not just brushed on, but generously coated. It added a sharp, rich kick that made every bite better. Easily one of the best tandoori-style chickens I’ve had.

Next was the mutton mandi. The mutton itself was cooked to perfection. Soft, tender, and done just right. That part deserves full marks. The rice and soup, though, were more on the mild side. They were flavorful in their own way but very light on masalas. Personally, I prefer bolder, spicier rice, so this ended up feeling just okay for me. I can see why others might love it, but it wasn’t fully my thing.

We finished with kunafa, which was a pleasant surprise. Not overly sweet, nicely balanced, and different from the usual heavy desserts. A good way to end the meal.

Service was excellent throughout, attentive without hovering, and the ambience was comfortable and well maintained.

Final takeaway: go for the Turkish tandoori chicken without thinking twice. Mandi is well made but suits those who enjoy milder flavors. Solid place overall with great service and a calm dining vibe.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Highly recommend this place. Just walked out heart and belly full. We went in with what was recommended, and it did not disappoint. Turkish tandoori is unusual yellow gravy mild spice and extremely flavourful. Order a roti or naan with it as it is semi gravy and will go along splendidly. The chicken sheekh kebab was tender and very good. We even ordered a side of just the Turkish gravy at an additional cost as a dipping side. If you have a large appetite, this is a good place. The mandi we ordered was Turkish which was flavoured rice with a side of soup that's given with the mandi and a piece of chicken on top. The rice has lot of flavour and more like saffron fried rice. Soup is hot peppery and more of a bone broth. The omali which is a  dessert, is served in a plastic box
It's bread milk pudding which a whole chunk of bread soaked in cream pudding. With shaved almonds on top. Quite sponge like and moist. The owner and host are attentive.
Parking is along the road and can get quite difficult as there is a banquet hall next to it and Dmart. As a local chemburkar quite happy with this place.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Today, some guest had arrived with out any notice. They were the biryani lovers. Hence we decided to order from Biryani by KILO. The delivery was quick and packing was extra ordinary. Along with the food they provided hand cleanser. This shows the management care towards our safety in covid.

We ordered:
Rara Mutton Biryani: BBK is the pioneer of fresh dum cooked handi biryani. For every order they serve you the freshly cooked Biryani. Long grained basmati rice was dum cooked with mutton, spices in a sealed handi. It was served with continental candle and a clay stand to pre heat the biryani. It was also served with gravy and rita. It was very delicious.

Mutton Galouti Kebab: Galouti means the things that melts in the mouth and that is what this kebab did in our mouth. The minced lamb meat was marinated in a mixture prepared by grinding ginger, garlic, coconut, cloves, cinnamon and red chillies. It was served with green chutney and onions. It  was so yummy that it simply vanished from our plates quickly.

Matka Phirni: Phirni is one of the most famous dish of Hyderabad. It is a classy dessert made with finely ground rice, gently simmered in a sweetened milk mixture and allowed to set. It was served in an earthen pot. It was tasty.

Overall it was liked by all of us. A reliable and safe source to order out when in need or when you want to eat quality biryani. Do order out from your nearest outlet.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Stars Parade is truly one of the best dining spots in Chembur, offering not just great food but exceptional service that elevates the entire experience.

The service was outstanding — from thoughtfully suggesting dishes to attentive table service throughout the meal, the staff ensured we were well taken care of at every step.

We started with Chicken Tandoori, which had a beautiful smoky tandoor flavor and was tender and juicy. The Chicken Manchow Soup was another highlight, perfectly spiced and comforting.

For the main course, we had Butter Garlic Naan, which was soft and flavorful, paired with a delicious Butter Chicken that stood out for its balanced taste — rich and flavorful without being overly sweet, unlike many versions served elsewhere. We also tried the Chicken Fried Rice, which was equally satisfying and well-prepared.

Overall, Stars Parade delivers consistently great flavors backed by excellent hospitality, making it a must-visit restaurant in Chembur.

featured_reviews.name: Nitesh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an amazing dining experience at Stars Parade Luxury Dining and it truly lived up to its name!

We ordered a variety of dishes including Tomato Soup, Manchow Soup, Chicken Butter, Fish Fry, and Prawns, and every single item was full of rich flavors and perfectly cooked. The soups were especially comforting, the tomato soup was smooth and creamy, while the Manchow soup had that perfect spicy kick and crunch.

The Chicken Butter was absolutely delicious, soft, juicy pieces cooked in a rich, creamy gravy that paired perfectly with roti and naan. The Fish Fry and Prawns were fresh, crispy, and well seasoned, making them a highlight of the meal. You can really tell they maintain good quality when it comes to seafood.

The ambience of the place is quite cozy and lively, perfect for family dinners or outings with friends. Even though it can get a bit crowded during peak hours, the staff manages things well and provides decent service. The restaurant is known for its mix of North Indian, Chinese, and seafood dishes, which gives a lot of variety to explore.

Overall, the combination of taste, variety, and satisfying portions makes this place worth visiting. Definitely a great spot if you are craving flavorful food and a nice dining experience in Chembur.

Highly recommended, will surely visit again! 👍🔥

In order to satisfy my evening hunger thought to try out non vegetarian food from Belly Darbar located at chembur. The Butter chicken roll was a big one which was totally filling for one person. It tasted good too. Little veggies as stuffing would be preferred. Also tasted a few chicken kebabs which was good but the taste can be improved.
The delivery was on time and the packaging was perfect. Non vegetarian food lovers do try out this place.

featured_reviews.name: Hetal Bhanushali
featured_reviews.review_text:
Called for some amazing indulgences from Belly Darbar and the food was too good! Here’s what I tried here:
Paneer Makhani Roll: This roll is their signature roll. Roll stuffed with loads of paneer pieces marinated in makhani gravy, which is not so spicy & creamy, is definitely a great choice for those who love non-spicy food. Also, this roll is pretty great at quantity, which may suffice one person’s meal.

Hyderabadi biryani: Packed with flavours, this biryani is for sure my best one, with some additional secret taste that makes this one worth having. Caramelised onions on the top, a layer of biryani with tasty gravy & paneer pieces was too good when it comes together! Must try!

Overall, my experience with Belly Darbar was amazing, they’re also maintaining appropriate hygiene levels, packed well, and great food with amazing quantity! They have an elaborate menu you can pick from! Check them out and call for it today!

featured_reviews.name: shweta narang
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an amazing experience with Belly Darbar, Chembur! The food was delicious and the service was truly buddy-like. A special thanks to Vishal, the owner, who made suggestions as if it was his own family event. They provide excellent support not just for grand occasions but also for small family gatherings.

Thank you, Belly Darbar & Vishal, for always being there and making every event memorable. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Nishad Kinhikar
featured_reviews.review_text:
This place really delivered a deliciously lip smacking meal. I ordered dal tadka and Darbari Makhmali which was really tasty.

Darbari Makhmali is a good combination of sliced paneer and a spicy flavour.
The food was well packed, fresh, hot, tasty. Never thought that this would be an wonderful experience.

Looking forward ordering again.

Dal tadka was as usual awesome. I request you guys to open up your seatings for dine in orders.

Try becoming a Zomato gold partner.

featured_reviews.name: Piyush Sinha
featured_reviews.review_text:
I ordered food for 10 people a night before. Here are the things I liked

1. Although the slots were sold out Vishal ji still cooperated and took our order

2. During the discussion, Vishal ji was very reasonable, he clubbed few things and added small items as complimentary, with a decent discount.

3. The food prices are reasonable. And menu is vast, you can chose indian, chinese, continental etc. Compared to restaurant the cost comes to be quite low
I ordered Indian veg and non veg

Final thing - Food delivered was very tasty. Our guests loved it. Chicken was soft and juicy, veg was cooked perfectly. Biryani was quite delicious. No food colour was used and food did not feel oily.

Overall a great experience. Recommended for everyone.

featured_reviews.name: Taapsi Ramchandani
featured_reviews.review_text: Tried this place for the first time based on online reviews. They did not disappoint! My guests were very impressed with the food. It was catered well (I took the chef option because I ordered Mexican food) and overall, it was a great experience. Would try them again when needed.

featured_reviews.name: Ashwini Sakhalkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Belly Darbar has done catering for many of our events. Usually we ask for just the food which is always tasty, well presented and most importantly hygienic. This time we asked for a proper catering service from them for our hospital staff party. And the service was exceptional. The servers were polite and prompt. Totally worth recommending!

featured_reviews.name: Aniruddh Srivastava
featured_reviews.review_text: Vishal is easily available to discuss food options and helps make the menu selection process easier. Catered veg and non-veg kebabs and biryani for 15 people. Everyone loved the unique flavours and good quantities.

customer_updates.name: Manzil Hemson
customer_updates.text: We celebrated our friend Naresh Mehta Uncle's 80th birthday at Jeevan Boarding House with our biggest friend group, and it was a fantastic experience! featured_reviews.name: Moumita Roy
featured_reviews.review_text: Jeevan Boarding House is a hidden gem in Chembur for anyone looking for simple, homely food at an unbeatable price. For just ₹100, you get a complete meal starting from chutney and accompaniments all the way to a sweet dish. The food is fresh, tasty, and feels like a home-cooked meal. The service is quick, and the overall experience is great value for money. A must-visit if you’re looking for an affordable and satisfying meal.

featured_reviews.name: ashish kumar
featured_reviews.review_text: Good food. Enjoyed the fresh south indian dinner delicacies in banana leaf...cost for each only Rs 110/- and legendary outlet since 1962. I have travelled this place near Chembur Station more than 100 times but today found out through Google maps. Very nice experience.

featured_reviews.name: Saakshi Shinde
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had a special southindian lunch served by Jeevan Thali at our office in marol. The thali had absolutely amazing and truly satisfying. The meal was a perfect balance of flavors, textures, and authenticity. From the moment it was served, the aroma itself was enough to make me excited to dig in.

The thali included a variety of dishes like sambar, rasam, different vegetable curries, chutneys, all served with soft rice, crispy papad, and perfectly made chapatis, puranpoli, paysam. Each item had its own distinct taste—rich, flavorful, and well-seasoned without being too heavy.

What stood out the most was the freshness and authenticity of the preparation. The service was also warm and attentive, adding to the overall experience.

Overall, it was a wholesome, delicious, and fulfilling meal that truly represents the essence of South Indian cuisine. Definitely a must-try for anyone who loves traditional and flavorful food!

featured_reviews.name: PARIMAL BORKAR
featured_reviews.review_text:
Jeevan Boarding House is very near from Chembur East station not even minutes long Very huge free space outside the hotel. No seperate parking for hotel and if Park vehicle near hotel Road it cause towing as NO PARKING.
Food is amazing, staff is best, the way of serving is different that they use Banana leaf for every unlimited food by heart serving the staff. Pineapple Bhaji was different in taste, it tastes so good ki mood ban jaye. Rassam, curd, papad, two more Bhaji, sweet dish and everything fulfilled and make you satisfied.
So many varieties you need to visit and just taste it, menu changes day to day so please confirm the menu if you want to test pineapple Bhaji.
Suggestion is go by train if you live away from Chembur or use public utilities.
Because parking is on drawback.

featured_reviews.name: Akash Mande
featured_reviews.review_text: Jeevan Boarding House, Chembur is a classic South Indian restaurant with a legacy going back to 1962. The place serves simple, authentic South Indian food at very affordable prices. The taste is consistent, homely, and reminds you of old-school eateries that focus more on food than frills. Portions are satisfying, service is quick, and the atmosphere has a nostalgic charm. A must-visit for anyone who enjoys traditional South Indian meals without burning a hole in the pocket.

featured_reviews.name: Ajinkya Girmal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently shifted to Mumbai from Kolhapur. Being a bachelor, I’m always in search of homely food at an affordable rate, and after three months, I finally found Jeevan Boarding House simply divine taste! 🫠

Actually, I discovered this place last week on Swiggy while looking for homely food at reasonable prices  something that rarely happens on food apps. But this time, I was lucky! I ordered their thali on Swiggy, and when the parcel arrived, I was pleasantly surprised to see so many delicious dishes packed together. That was the first time I tasted their food.

Today, while returning home, I decided to visit their premises and what a pleasant surprise! Polite service, tempting South Indian dishes, from tangy tomato curry to sweet rice kheer simply divine! 😋 Only in 100 Rs serving on banana leaf

Highly recommend

featured_reviews.name: Gokulraj
featured_reviews.review_text:
Jeevan Boarding House in Chembur is a great spot if you're looking for delicious South Indian meals on a budget!

The ambiance is simple but pleasant, and the food is absolutely worth it.

It’s conveniently located—just a 1-minute walk from Chembur station—making it super easy to reach.

Their meals (Thali) are priced at just ₹90, which is a steal for the quality and quantity you get. Everything served beyond the basic meal is charged extra, but still very affordable.

Meals are served traditionally on a banana leaf, which adds to the authentic experience. The taste is amazing—especially their pineapple sweet and payasam, which are both top notch. You definitely won’t leave hungry, as the portions are more than enough!

Be prepared to wait if you visit during peak hoursit gets quite crowded after 1 PM, but the food is worth the wait. 😄

Highly recommended for anyone craving wholesome South Indian food!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Best South Indian Restaurant in Chembur – Mani’s Lunch Home

The ambience is clean, calm, and comfortable, making it perfect for family lunches or peaceful meals. The staff is polite, quick, and well-trained, and the service is always prompt. You can really feel the care they put into both food quality and customer experience.

If you are searching for the best South Indian restaurant in Chembur, Mani’s Lunch Home is a must-visit. Great taste, nice environment, and excellent service make it stand out.

Highly recommended for South Indian food lovers in Mumbai.

The aesthetic of Banana Leaf is really nice — clean, warm, and gives off a cozy South Indian vibe.

We tried quite a few dishes. The Benne Sada Dosa and Benne Masala Dosa were both good, and the bhaji inside the Benne Masala Dosa had a unique flavor that stood out. The chutneys were flavorful and complemented the dosas really well.

We also ordered the Mini Podi Idli and Onion Uttapam, and both tasted great. To finish off, we had filter coffee — both hot and cold versions — and really enjoyed them.

The only thing that didn’t quite meet expectations was the Medu Vada; it could have been better in taste.

Overall, a pleasant dining experience with good food and a lovely ambiance!

featured_reviews.name: Nitin Jeswani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I ordered Sindhi mutton and chapatis through Swiggy, and I must say the experience was quite disappointing.

As someone familiar with Sindhi cuisine, the mutton did not resemble it in any way. it was largely flavourless, I could only taste oil and chilli.

Additionally, the chapatis seemed stale, as though they had been prepared much earlier in the day and simply reheated before packaging.

Overall, the quality was very very bad.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you for your detailed feedback.

We’re genuinely sorry that your experience with the Sindhi mutton and chapatis did not meet expectations.

On the Sindhi mutton, we understand that regional dishes carry very specific flavour profiles, and it seems we missed the mark for you. Your feedback about it feeling oily and lacking depth is noted, and we will review the recipe and execution with our kitchen team.

Regarding the chapatis, they are prepared fresh in batches during service, but they should never feel stale. What you experienced is not acceptable, and we will be tightening our process to ensure better consistency, especially for delivery orders.

We take feedback like this seriously, as it helps us improve. We hope you’ll consider giving us another chance to deliver a much better experience.

We also have a fully functional AC family section upstairs, which has been at full capacity due to peak summer demand. It’s unclear how this was missed by you, but our staff is always available to assist.

Now, regarding your comment about “labour class, rickshaw wala, bachelors”  we strongly disagree with that mindset. We’re proud to serve people from all walks of life. Respect for customers isn’t based on labels, and we don’t design our space to exclude anyone. If inclusivity feels uncomfortable, that’s not a reflection of our standards, it’s a reflection of your perspective.

On the food, taste is subjective, but stating that our mutton felt like beef is factually incorrect and misleading. We serve exactly what is listed on our menu. If such claims are being made, they should be supported with evidence, otherwise they fall under misinformation and slander

We’re sorry your expectations weren’t met, but we stand by our food, and the diverse customer base we’re proud to serve.
Team Roastwala.

featured_reviews.review_text:
This restaurant has really won me over with their menu! I love the cozy vibe of this place, and all the service staff were so amazing and nice. I came here with my friend, and we tried lots of things, and each one of them was great!

They also make pizza in a traditional wood-fired oven, so we tried the Pannazo Sandwich and Farmers Choice Pizza, and both were just fabulous! The Pannazzo Sandwich was literally a flavor bomb! I highly recommend it.

They've also started their new Christmas menu, and I tried the Pink Wasabi Strawberry Sushi - it's something unique, something I'd never had before, and I love it!

My friend ordered a mocktail named White Christmas: it was a tender coconut-based cocktail, and he enjoyed the drink a lot, so I'll recommend this as well.

We also tried their Plant Protein Schezwan Sizzler, and OMG, this was so fulfilling - a perfect main course.

Last but not least, we ordered a Christmas special dessert named Christmas Matcha: this dessert came with table drama, and it's basically a cheesecake covered with matcha cream and decorated to resemble a Christmas tree. Taste-wise, this was 10/10! I highly recommend this!

featured_reviews.name: Tanishka Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Spice Laundry and honestly loved every bit of it.
The ambience is adorable, classy, and very welcoming.
The Checkmate Sushi in black and white looked beautiful and was filled with avocado, cucumber, and cream cheese, making it light and creamy.
The Jennifer Aniston Quinoa Bowl had red quinoa, sweet potato chips, boiled beetroot, avocado, chickpeas, broccoli, kale, hummus, sunflower seeds, and a cashew–jaggery dressing, which was wholesome and tasty.
The Berry Merry mocktail with fresh strawberry, mixed berry purée, pineapple foam, and fizz was refreshing.
Dragon’s Kiss was a lovely fusion of lychee and dragon fruit, sweet and exotic.
The Pav Bhaji Fondue was a spicy mashed veggie mix with cheese, served hot with croutons.
The Cheese Wheel Pasta was rich and creamy, tossed fresh in a parmesan cheese wheel.
We ended with the Hazelnut Strawberry Pull Me Up Cake, which was indulgent and delicious.
Everything felt gourmet and well presented.
One of the best vegetarian food spots in Chembur for sure. 💛🍽️

featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely loved my experience at Spice Laundry! The food, presentation and overall vibe were amazing. They’re currently hosting a Parsi Food Festival, which made the visit even more exciting. The Palanji Mojito was super refreshing, and the Tandoori Jhol Momo Soup was warm and comforting with great flavours.

The Nani Ka Naan Bomb was a standout starter, perfectly loaded with cheese and makhani sauce. For mains, the Stuffed Paneer Parda Biryani was beautifully presented, sealed with dough and opened fresh at the table, releasing the most incredible aroma.

They also have a great weekday pizza and iced tea offer, and the farmhouse pizza paired with peach iced tea was a perfect combo. We ended the meal with the Pull Me Up Rasmalai Tres Leches, which was absolutely delicious and the perfect sweet finish.

Great food, thoughtful presentation and a lovely overall experience. Definitely recommend visiting! ✨🍽️

featured_reviews.name: Suraj Jobanputra
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an absolutely wonderful experience at this Parsi restaurant! From the moment we walked in, the warm lighting, vintage décor, and subtle old-Bombay charm created such a beautiful and nostalgic ambience. The vibe felt cozy yet lively — perfect for both a relaxed family dinner and a special evening out.

The food was truly the highlight. Every dish was bursting with authentic Parsi flavours — perfectly balanced, rich, and comforting. You can genuinely taste the tradition and love in the preparation. From the starters to the desserts, everything was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented.

Great food, soulful vibes, and a lovely ambience — definitely a place I’d visit again and recommend to anyone who appreciates authentic Parsi cuisine and a charming dining experience. We tried nachos, Sicilian lasagna, keema pattice, Mexican sizzler, manchow soup and Belgium chocolate pastry and all turned out to be good.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited this place yesterday and really enjoyed the overall experience. If you’re someone who loves authentic Maharashtrian cuisine, especially seafood, this place is definitely worth trying. The food quality was genuinely very good and the flavors felt authentic and fresh.

What stood out the most for me was the ambience, the friendliness of the staff, and the overall service. The staff was polite, welcoming, and attentive throughout the visit.

That said, there are a few areas where the restaurant can improve. Firstly, they should consider replacing the plastic glasses with real glass ones, as the current ones had turned yellow over time. Also, the glass served with my cold drink had a noticeable essence/smell of solkadhi, which made the drink feel slightly oily or buttery in taste, I preferred drinking directly through the bottle.

Another thing was the waiting time for the Komdi Vade. The restaurant wasn’t particularly crowded when I visited, but the dish still took around 40 minutes. When I followed up on the order, the waiter went into the kitchen and brought it out within a minute. Since the vade were hot, I’m not sure whether the food had been waiting in the kitchen already or if it was simply a coincidence that it got ready right after I asked.

Overall, despite a few shortcomings, the food and hospitality made the visit enjoyable. A solid 4-star experience.
